data_provenance.architectural_basis: curated national tuning over detailed CWR region
data_provenance.geography_basis: bundled low-resolution country geometry from generation-time countryinfo/Natural-Earth-derived data when available; manual envelope fallback for selected small territories
data_provenance.editor_note: Country data is a procedural default, not a statement that all buildings in the country share one style. Explicit OSM tags override these defaults.

country_overview: Rendered masonry, timber and concrete with broad pitched tile/metal roofs and ventilation-focused openings dominate many regions.

rural.description: Masonry, concrete, and timber traditions with varied roof profiles. Rendered/concrete or brick walls, tiled/hipped rural roofs, flat urban roofs, aluminium windows and sliding or hinged doors.

architectural_details.scope_note: Procedural regional defaults only. Explicit OSM tags such as building:material, roof:shape, roof:material, height, building:levels, entrance and mapped openings should override these heuristics.
architectural_details.climate_response: Humid continental, monsoon, subtropical and cold regions; modern construction varies from tiled low-rise to dense concrete urban stock.
architectural_details.architectural_character: Rendered/concrete or brick walls, tiled/hipped rural roofs, flat urban roofs, aluminium windows and sliding or hinged doors.

materials.trim_guidance: tile/stone surrounds, restrained painted trim and projecting sun/rain hoods

types: pier/post for selected timber vernacular buildings
foundation.uneven_terrain_strategy: extend foundation skirt below local building datum; never stretch facade walls down to terrain

details: gutters/downpipes where rainfall/snow makes them plausible
ridge/eave trim matched to roof material
chimneys primarily on residential stock where climate/style supports them

windows.glazing: single to double glazing; insulated glazing increases in colder/high-rise contexts
windows.trim: tile/stone surrounds, restrained painted trim and projecting sun/rain hoods

placement.ground_floor: keep sill above foundation/plinth; avoid door clearance zones
placement.upper_floors: align vertically when facade style is regular; omit on utility families unless explicitly mapped
placement.gable_walls: allow smaller centred opening only when enough wall area exists
placement.corners: keep at least the configured edge margin from each corner

garage.use_when: outbuilding classified as garage or OSM explicitly tags garage/garages

placement.preferred_facade: long accessible exterior wall unless mapped entrance identifies a facade
placement.foundation_transition: pedestrian threshold/step for ordinary doors; broad ramp for vehicle-scale garage/barn/warehouse openings

residential.window_rule: regular room-scaled bays; avoid corners; 1-3 openings per usable wall depending on length
residential.door_rule: one primary pedestrian entry; secondary/service door optional on long footprints

townhouse.window_rule: vertically align openings by storey where practical
townhouse.door_rule: narrow pedestrian entrance, usually one per street-facing unit

urban.window_rule: repeat bays by storey; ground floor may use larger commercial/opening proportions
urban.door_rule: primary street entrance plus optional service entrance

agricultural.window_rule: barns are windowless; agricultural entrances and ventilation details carry the facade

outbuilding.window_rule: sheds and garages are windowless; utility doors define the facade
outbuilding.door_rule: shed uses pedestrian utility door; garage uses vehicle-scale door when footprint can fit a car

industrial.window_rule: warehouses are usually windowless; uncommon glazing is sparse clerestory/fixed utility glazing rather than domestic bays

school.window_rule: larger repeated classroom windows with consistent sill and head heights
school.door_rule: paired or glazed institutional entrance, plus service/egress doors

shop.window_rule: street facade favours large fixed/storefront glazing; side/rear walls use ordinary or service windows
shop.door_rule: glazed commercial door or local shop entry; roller shutter may accompany storefront

cabin.description: Small residential cabin/cottage. Defaults to one storey unless explicit OSM height/building:levels says otherwise.

cottage.description: Small cottage/house. Two levels are allowed automatically, with the regional roof-storey probability deciding whether the upper level is integrated into the roof.

apartments.description: Apartment building. Regional roof-storey probability may integrate only the top level into a compatible gabled roof.

roof_storeys.description: Optional top storey integrated inside a steep gabled roof. Regular upper facade windows are removed; daylight is provided only through windows in gable-end side walls. Dormers and roof-slope windows are intentionally excluded by this profile.

window_policy.description: Place one or two room-sized windows only in vertical gable triangles. Never repeat the normal upper-floor bay pattern on eave walls.
